summary.text: Mark Hiner is a Republican state representative from Ohio who has represented District 98 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him as a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Mark Hiner earned an M.B.A. and a degree in broadcast engineering technology, and his career experience includes working as a small business owner, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia also lists him as affiliated with the Buckeye Firearms Association and the National Rifle Association.
Hiner won the District 98 seat in the November 2024 general election and took office on January 1, 2025.
In 2025–2026 he is vice chair of the Arts, Athletics, and Tourism Committee and a member of the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Small Business committees.
He advanced unopposed from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Scott Grund in the general election.
